LanguageData.RimMult.SteamRequired: RimMult needs Steam: start RimWorld through Steam to play multiplayer.
LanguageData.RimMult.PortInUse: Could not open UDP port {0}. Is another server already using it?
LanguageData.RimMult.CannotJoinSelf: You can't join your own game.

LanguageData.RimMult.NoFriendsHosting: None of your friends is hosting right now.
LanguageData.RimMult.JoinHint: You can also join a friend from the Steam friends list: right-click them → "Join game".

LanguageData.RimMult.HostingInfo: Friends can join from the Steam friends list.

LanguageData.RimMult.WrongPasswordHint: Enter the password in the "Password" field and join again.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModExtra: Not on the server: {0} ({1}) — disable it
LanguageData.RimMult.ModOrder: Same mods, but in a different load order. Match the host's order.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModSettingsDiffer: Your mod list differs from the server's.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModListHashHint: Put this into "ModListHash" in a dedicated server's server.json to pin the required mod list.
